points.why: Names a balancing loop with an information delay (10-min window) and a material delay (8-min boot) that cause overshoot and swing-back.
Explicitly says bigger batches are reacting harder to a stale signal and will enlarge the swings.
Recommends faster boot and warm pools, proportional partial correction with re-measurement, and a wider band, and warns that a 2-minute window risks flapping.
